about_the_game:
Go North is the first immersive maze adventure ever. With the help of numerous magical and technological items, navigate beautifully unique mazes and explore expansive worlds in a story-driven adventure like no other.

Story

It is said that the Maze God resides at the northernmost part of the world and that he grants one wish to any adventurer brave and clever enough to reach him.

Dara begins her journey with a singular purpose: to Go North, meet the Maze God and have her undying wish granted.

She must navigate countless mazes and labyrinths purposefully crafted by the Maze Makers to test her perseverance. But something sinister seems to be corrupting the mazes. Something… or someone.

Features

  • Navigate beautiful mazes in 3rd person: walk around atmospheric and gorgeous mazes while discovering different items, characters, puzzles and stories.

  • Find, keep and use unique and helpful items scattered around each maze ranging from simple items like a hoverboard to more elaborate items like a robot mouse that scurries towards the exit.

  • Solve puzzles and avoid obstacles: use your wits to solve the different puzzles and obstacles within each maze. decipher different riddles and clues to uncover secret passages, items and easter eggs.

  • Multiplayer: compete online against your friends and players across the globe, cross-platform.

  • Arcade: explore an infinite amount of cleverly generated mazes of varying forms and worlds.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS X 10.15, or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 2 GB of RAM minimum
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Wander a world filled with cleverly-crafted mazes. Whoever can solve them all gets their wish granted by the Maze God. Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other maze explorers complete unusual side quests in the first immersive maze adventure ever!
